planned.description: Long run — 19 km at easy pace (6:30-7:00/km)

daily_comment.summary: Went out for a planned 19 km easy long run and ended up running an improvised half marathon — 21.1 km at 6:01/km. That's 2.1 km over target and ~30 sec/km faster than the planned 6:30-7:00/km range, with avg HR of 168 bpm (Zone 4 territory) instead of the intended Zone 2. The run produced 25 Strava PRs and a half-marathon best effort of 2:07:53 — an excellent fitness marker 12 weeks out from Porto.
did_right: Exceeded the distance target: 21.1 km vs planned 19 km, completing a full half marathon — the longest effort of the training block so far
25 segment PRs and a half-marathon time of 2:07:53 demonstrate real fitness gains and readiness to race in September
Consistent single-effort pacing throughout 21 km — the lap data shows no blowup in the second half
to_improve: Pace was 6:01/km vs target 6:30-7:00/km — avg HR of 168 bpm confirms this was a Zone 4 effort, not Zone 2. On future long runs keep HR below ~145 bpm even if it means slowing to 6:45+/km; aerobic base adaptation happens at lower intensities

With a VO2max interval session planned for this Wednesday, running this hard on Sunday compresses recovery time — monitor fatigue on Monday-Tuesday and consider making those days fully passive rest if legs feel heavy
